changes: Sub-user reports print as cashbooks with Money In / Money Out, original receipt references and category summaries in Submitted review, each user workspace and Report History.

After final approval, choose Consolidated category totals, Detailed with each fund totaled once, or As entered individual transactions. Preview the actual debit and credit lines before using them in Journal.
Use in Journal explicitly opens the main Journal, including when AI Journal was previously selected. Post Entry stays a separate action; Cancel preserves the current draft.

Consolidated and fund-total formats use one editable journal date within the report month. Original source dates stay linked; currencies, rates and debit/credit sides remain separate. Approval, period locks, source verification and duplicate protection remain enforced.
